title: Who played in Sharky and Leon Prima's band
summary: Fougerat recalls Shields, Monk or drummer Leo Addy, and trombonist Julian Lane in that band.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Yeah, I would like to know some more about that band that Sharky and Leon Prima had together. Who was in there with them?

Well, I think Shields was in that band, and Monk. I think Monk was back around in that band. And if it wasn't Monk, it was a barber named Leo Hadd. He was a fine drummer, and he died too. And I really don't know all the rest of them in that band. I can't think off, Hadd, but I know it is a mighty fine band. A very good band.
Oh yeah, that was old Julian Lane. He was a dead man. He was a man.
